sentences.text: Five voices open the book.
The dog hears what we miss.
And you listened to the dog.
That is how we survive.
That is how we keep what is ours.
Masan, the Matriarch.
My father wasn't saving paper.
He was saving code.
The code of who we are...
The book hasn't been burned.
It's just waiting for you to open it again.
Vytautas, the Iron Wolf.
The land remembers you.
You just have to remember it back.
Hastiin, the Singer.
A people can lose everything — the land, the language, even the names — and still find their way home, so long as someone keeps the songs.
Ona, the Song Keeper.
The sword without the brush is mere brutality.
The brush without the sword is vulnerable sentiment.
Together, they form the complete guardian.
The Warrior-Samurai, the Sword and Brush.
